snippet.title: Rita release date trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Rita is a cozy adventure where a little chicklet solves word-based puzzles to transform the world around her. Follow her story across generations, meet her grandchicklet, and be a part of her legacy.

Rita by @sporktank  is releasing July 30th, 2026!

Rita in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/rita/
Rita on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2984850/Rita/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
